svg.title: Interpret the interaction before the averages
svg.desc: B averages 92 percent and A 93 percent across both matrices. The B-minus-A comparison is +4 percentage points in river water and −6 in wastewater. The interaction test supports a change in the contrast across water matrices. Individual pair differences require their own uncertainty estimates.
svg.text: The overall comparison hides two different gaps
Across matrices: B averages 92%, A averages 93%.

g.text: Report the matrix-specific gaps with confidence intervals.
